title: Complete home address and country of residence
goal: Every new employee gives a complete postal address once, so HR can post documents, and its country tells the other steps whether the employee lives in Switzerland.
context: HR posts many documents to employees and needs the complete address as written on an envelope: street, number, postcode, town and country, with no extra parts (F-TR-009, F-TR-010). The country of the home address is also the employee's country of residence (F-TR-040, G-09). Several later questions depend on it. Employees living abroad are always subject to source tax (F-TR-034, F-TR-037), and the pension fund canton is asked only of employees living in Switzerland. This feature therefore comes before the pension and source tax features that depend on it.

stories.title: Complete postal address for HR mail
stories.i_want: every new employee to give their complete home address (street, house number, postcode, town and country) as it would be written on an envelope
stories.so_that: I can post documents to the employee without chasing missing address parts
stories.priority_reason: HR posts many documents to employees and states the address 'has to be complete'; an incomplete address blocks HR's postal communication (F-TR-010).

acceptance_criteria.title: All address parts are always asked and required
acceptance_criteria.given: a new employee is filling in the onboarding questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.when: they reach the home address step
acceptance_criteria.then: they are asked for street, house number, postcode, town and country of their home address, and cannot complete the step while any of these five parts is empty

acceptance_criteria.title: Normal postal address with no extra parts
acceptance_criteria.given: a new employee is at the home address step
acceptance_criteria.then: only the parts of a normal postal address as written on an envelope are asked (street, house number, postcode, town, country); no further address parts are asked

acceptance_criteria.title: Address is asked once and received by HR
acceptance_criteria.given: a new employee has completed the home address step
acceptance_criteria.when: the onboarding data is made available to the receiving parties
acceptance_criteria.then: HR receives the complete home address, and the employee is not asked for the address again in any later step

stories.title: Country of home address as country of residence
stories.i_want: the country of the employee's home address to be used as their country of residence
stories.so_that: employees living abroad are recognised as subject to source tax and only the questions relevant to where the employee lives are asked later
stories.priority_reason: Whether the employee lives in Switzerland decides source tax liability (F-TR-034, F-TR-037) and which later questions are asked; without it later steps cannot be determined.

acceptance_criteria.title: Country of residence is not asked separately
acceptance_criteria.given: a new employee has given the country of their home address
acceptance_criteria.when: a later step needs to know whether the employee lives in Switzerland
acceptance_criteria.then: the country of the home address is used as the country of residence and the employee is not asked a separate question about where they live

acceptance_criteria.title: Employees living abroad are subject to source tax whatever their nationality
acceptance_criteria.given: a new employee's home address is outside Switzerland
acceptance_criteria.when: the questionnaire determines the following steps
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee is treated as subject to source tax, is not asked their nationality or the pension fund canton, and source tax and HR receive the country of residence

acceptance_criteria.title: Employees living in Switzerland continue to nationality and canton
acceptance_criteria.given: a new employee's home address is in Switzerland
acceptance_criteria.when: the questionnaire determines the following steps
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee is asked their nationality and the pension fund canton, which decide the later source tax and pension steps

acceptance_criteria.title: Address comes before dependent steps
acceptance_criteria.given: a new employee starts the onboarding questionnaire
acceptance_criteria.then: the home address step comes before the pension and source tax steps that depend on the country of residence; the additional source tax questions for employees living abroad are defined by the Zurich calculator and remain open (OQ-01)
